blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–The Philippine Blu Girls will play for bronze in women’s softball of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 after closing out the preliminary round with a 9-3 win over Hong Kong on Friday. Angelu Gabriel, Reyae Villamin and Roma Jane Cruz all homered as the Blu Girls ended the preliminaries in fourth spot with a 4-3 win-loss record and a chance to secure a podium finish. Gabriel hit a solo homer in the top of the first, Villamin’s two-run shot highlighted a five-run second before Cruz hit one out […]...
